page.overview:
What is Balloon?

Balloon belongs to Minecraft. Balloons are entities that float upward when placed.

Balloons are available in the Creative inventory or commands in Education Edition only. When a balloon is shot by an arrow or a trident, or floats into a solid block, it pops, summons particles, and is destroyed. A balloon tied to a fence post bursts when a player strikes it in any direction.
